word: I had no idea what I wanted to do with my life, and no idea how college was going to help me figure it out.
meaning: 我完全不知道自己這輩子想做什麼，也不知道大學能怎麼幫我想清楚這件事。
example: He had no direction in life and could not see how staying in school would help.
hint:
中文解釋：道出許多年輕人的困惑——不知道人生方向，也不確定學校能給答案。
1) had no idea (phr.): 完全不知道；syn: was clueless; ant: knew exactly
2) figure it out (phr.): 想清楚、弄明白；syn: work it out; ant: remain confused
pronunciation: Honest: I had NO I-dea | what I WANT-ed to do | with my LIFE.

word: And here I was, spending all of the money my parents had saved their entire life.
meaning: 而我就這樣，把父母用一輩子積攢下來的所有積蓄都花掉了。
example: He realized he was wasting his parents' lifetime savings without a clear purpose.
hint:
中文解釋：帶著強烈的愧疚感回顧當時的狀況——父母的心血被他消耗殆盡。
1) spending (v.): 花費；syn: using up; ant: saving
2) entire life (phr.): 整個一生；syn: whole lifetime; ant: a short time
pronunciation: Guilt + weight: HERE I WAS | SPEND-ing ALL | their EN-tire LIFE's SAV-ings.

word: So I decided to drop out and trust that it would all work out OK.
meaning: 於是我決定退學，並相信一切終究都會好的。
example: He made the bold decision to leave school, believing things would turn out fine.
hint:
中文解釋：做出勇敢的決定——退學，並選擇信任未來。
1) drop out (v.): 退學；syn: quit school; ant: graduate
2) work out (phr.): 順利解決、一切都好；syn: turn out fine; ant: fall apart
pronunciation: Decisive: I de-CI-ded to DROP OUT | and TRUST | that it would ALL WORK OUT OK.

word: It was pretty scary at the time, but looking back it was one of the best decisions I ever made.
meaning: 當時確實非常害怕，但回頭來看，那是我做過最好的決定之一。
example: The decision felt frightening then, but in hindsight it was among his wisest choices.
hint:
中文解釋：呈現「當下恐懼、事後明智」的對比，鼓勵聽眾勇於做艱難選擇。
1) scary (adj.): 令人害怕的；syn: frightening; ant: reassuring
2) looking back (phr.): 回頭看、事後回顧；syn: in hindsight; ant: looking forward
pronunciation: Contrast: PRET-ty SCAR-y at the TIME | but LOOK-ing BACK | one of the BEST de-CI-sions.

word: The minute I dropped out, I could stop taking the required classes that didn't interest me, and begin dropping in on the ones that looked far more interesting.
meaning: 就在我退學的那一刻起，我可以不再修那些我沒興趣的必修課，開始旁聽那些看起來有趣得多的課。
example: As soon as he left school officially, he was free to choose only the courses he truly enjoyed.
hint:
中文解釋：退學帶來的意外自由——不再被課表綁死，可以主動追求興趣。
1) required classes (n.): 必修課；syn: mandatory courses; ant: elective classes
2) dropping in on (phr.): 旁聽、順道參加；syn: attending informally; ant: enrolled in
pronunciation: Freedom: the MIN-ute I dropped OUT | STOP tak-ing RE-quired | DROP-ping IN on in-TER-est-ing ones.

example: He admits the experience was not as idealistic as it might sound.
hint:
中文解釋：轉折語——提醒聽眾退學生活並非詩情畫意，有實際的艱苦。
1) romantic (adj.): 浪漫的、理想化的；syn: idealistic; ant: harsh
2) wasn't all (phr.): 並非全都是；syn: not entirely; ant: completely was
pronunciation: Reality check: It WAS-n't ALL ro-MAN-tic. (slight pause before 'romantic')

word: I didn't have a dorm room, so I slept on the floor in friends' rooms.
meaning: 我沒有宿舍房間，所以睡在朋友房間的地板上。
example: Without a place to stay, he spent nights sleeping on his friends' floors.
hint:
中文解釋：具體描述退學後的艱苦生活——連個固定住所都沒有。
1) dorm room (n.): 宿舍房間；syn: dormitory; ant: private apartment
2) slept on the floor (phr.): 睡地板；syn: roughed it; ant: slept in a bed
pronunciation: Matter-of-fact: I did-n't have a DORM ROOM | so I SLEPT on the FLOOR | in FRIENDS' rooms.

word: I returned Coke bottles for the five-cent deposits to buy food with.
meaning: 我靠著退可口可樂瓶換取五美分押金來買食物。
example: He collected empty Coke bottles and returned them for small change to buy meals.
hint:
中文解釋：生動的細節——靠著微薄的瓶子押金維持生計，展現當時的貧窮。
1) returned (v.): 退還（換取押金）；syn: gave back; ant: kept
2) deposit (n.): 押金；syn: refund; ant: payment
pronunciation: Vivid: re-TURNED Coke BOT-tles | FIVE-cent de-POS-its | to BUY FOOD with.
